subject: Expansion: New Edge Environment (us-east-2) + License top-up at renewal
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cardinalhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Capacity request: new private env + renewal top-up

Hi Kimberly,

We're planning an expansion ahead of our December renewal. We need a new Private environment in us-east-2 to isolate analytics workloads for a new BU. High-level asks:
- 3 additional clusters (prod/staging/qa)
- Dedicated encryption at rest with customer-managed keys
- Expected baseline: 250 qps, spikes to 1k qps for 2 hours/day

Can you share a rough timeline, lift & shift support, and an estimate for the license/top-up and any term changes required? I've attached a draft PO (Cardinal-PO-draft.pdf).

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Cloud Procurement
Cardinal Health

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request: new private env + renewal top-up

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the PO draft.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sizing call (30 min) so our SEs can validate QPS assumptions and network requirements — are you available Mon/Tue?
2) We'll draft an amendment that adds the environment and the license top-up vs. extending term. Option A = 12-month top-up at 10% list; Option B = 24-month term extension for a 15% blended rate. I'll include both in the draft.
3) SOW outline & timeline: provisioning is typically 5–7 weeks from signed amendment assuming access to network/VPN. We'll include migration assist hours in the SOW.

I've attached the amendment draft and a short SOW outline. Copying Karthik for commercial alignment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T08:24:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Capacity request — quick sizing notes

Kim,

Quick notes after a pass on Elena's numbers:
- 3 clusters sounds right: prod (4x A100-ish equivalents for steady 250 qps), staging (2x), qa (1x).
- KV cache warmup: allow 24–48h for traffic shaping; recommend prefix caching for analytics queries.
- Encryption: support CMK via AWS KMS — will need terraform snippets and IAM principals from Cardinal.
- Lead time: 5 weeks for env provisioning + 1 week for testing + migration windows.
- Ops: recommend 40 hours of migration engineering and a 2-week canary.

I'll draft resource counts and a cost delta estimate by EOD; flagging Marcus for onboarding timeline and runbook.

-Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T09:10:00-05:00
Subject: Proposal: Private env provisioning + amendment options

Elena — following up with a concise proposal based on our internal sizing.

Summary:
- New private environments in us-east-2: prod (4 nodes), staging (2 nodes), qa (1 node)
- Migration services: 40 eng hours + 1 week canary
- Security: CMK via AWS KMS, TLS mutual auth, audit logging enabled

Commercial options (at a glance):
- Option A (12-month top-up): one-time license top-up = $195,000; provisioning & migration = $35,000
- Option B (24-month extension): blended committed spend with 15% discount = $300,000 (covers capacity + migration)

Timeline: 5–7 weeks from signed amendment + network access. I've attached an amendment draft (redwood-amendment-draft.docx) and SOW outline (sow-outline.pdf). If you're comfortable, send an approved PO and we'll issue a formal amendment for signature (DocuSign link provided).

Would you like me to lock Option A pricing and start the amendment, or set up a short call with Neha and Marcus to finalize technical details?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-amendment-draft.docx, sow-outline.pdf

From: procurement@cardinalhealth.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-06T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Private env provisioning + amendment options

Kim,

Thanks — we will proceed with Option A. Please send the amendment and a final PO request to sign. I have attached the internal PO approval note (Cardinal-PO-draft.pdf) for reference.

Elena (on behalf of Procurement)
